Did the agent touch its own tests? Every PR merged on t27, checked

Every pull request merged on gHashTag/t27 in 14 days, bee lane and human lane: which added tests, changed them or removed asserts, with the exact test lines from git.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gh 2.83.2, gh api graphql on gHashTag/t27: search is:pr is:merged, one day at a time, with head branch, author, merge commit and the file list GitHub reports
  • git 2.52.0 on a shallow bare clone of t27 master: git diff -M <merge>^1 <merge>, -U1000000 for .t27 files and -U0 for the rest
  • node scripts/widget-data/test-touch.mjs: classifies every patch with the rule in this spec and writes public/widgets/test-touch/data.json with its UTC time
